STEP 1 - Scene: A plated lunch/dinner with a baked pasta-style item (lasagna or cannelloni-like roll with melted cheese and tomato sauce), breaded or sauced chicken pieces, brown rice with vegetables, broccoli, and a side salad of romaine-type leaves with dressing.

STEP 2 - Vessel: White square/rounded dinner plate, roughly 26 cm. Area = 3.14 x 13^2 ≈ 530 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- Romaine/mixed leafy salad with dressing
- Baked cheese-topped pasta roll (cannelloni/lasagna-style)
- Sauced chicken pieces
- Brown rice with peppers and tomato
- Broccoli florets (two pieces, one roasted)
- Tofu or cheese cube, bell pepper pieces

STEP 4 - Area (percent of plate, total ~80%):
- Salad leaves: 22% = 117 cm²
- Baked pasta roll: 14% = 74 cm²
- Sauced chicken: 16% = 85 cm²
- Brown rice with vegetables: 18% = 95 cm²
- Broccoli: 6% = 32 cm²
- Pepper/tomato/tofu extras: 4% = 21 cm²

STEP 5 - Volume (area x height):
- Salad: 117 x 3 = 351 ml
- Pasta roll: 74 x 2.5 = 185 ml
- Chicken: 85 x 2 = 170 ml
- Rice/veg: 95 x 1.8 = 171 ml
- Broccoli: 32 x 2 = 64 ml
- Extras: 21 x 1.5 = 32 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Salad: 351 x 0.15 = 53 g
- Pasta roll: 185 x 0.9 = 167 g
- Chicken: 170 x 0.9 = 153 g
- Rice/veg: 171 x 0.8 = 137 g
- Broccoli: 64 x 0.55 = 35 g
- Extras: 32 x 0.6 = 19 g
Total ≈ 564 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Salad with dressing: 53 g x 40 kcal/100g = 21 kcal (dressing adds some; use 40)
- Pasta roll: 167 g x 190 = 317 kcal
- Chicken: 153 g x 180 = 275 kcal
- Rice/veg: 137 g x 115 = 158 kcal
- Broccoli: 35 g x 34 = 12 kcal
- Extras: 19 g x 60 = 11 kcal
Total ≈ 794 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A well-filled dinner plate with about 560 g of food and roughly 800 kcal is plausible for a restaurant-style plated meal with a cheese-heavy pasta portion.
